known_behavior_summary: The encounter is three independent djinns: Anshal (West/Life), Nezir (North/Frost), and Rohash (East/Wind), on map 754.

Current guides agree that the raid is split across platforms and all three djinns must be killed within a synchronized window; Wowhead explicitly reports 60 seconds and full-health respawn when that window is missed.

The repository uses a 65-yard platform-distance check, rejects vehicle targets, stops a djinn attacking a victim outside its home platform, and escalates an out-of-range warning aura; this is implementation evidence, not a 4.4.2 retail contract.

The repository instance controller energizes all three bosses through world trigger 21252, announces near-full strength at 80 seconds, sends all three ultimates at 90 seconds, and schedules a global eight-minute Berserk. Current sources describe 90 or 100 energy and approximately 90 seconds; the exact Classic threshold/cadence is blocked.

Anshal periodically places Soothing Breeze, summons five Ravenous Creepers, and uses Zephyr at full strength; Nezir applies Wind Chill, Permafrost, Ice Patch, and Sleet Storm; Rohash uses Slicing Gale, Tornadoes, Wind Blast, and Hurricane.

The local script prevents lethal damage while a single djinn is below 1%, marks it as gathering strength, and kills all three only when the other two are also gathering; the guide-reported 60-second reset/respawn rule is not encoded as a local timer.
Heroic-only local behavior is Rohash Storm Shield. The source contains an achievement spell identity (94119 Stay Chill) but no active cast path for it, so achievement credit is not asserted.

lifecycle.engage: Setting DATA_CONCLAVE_OF_WIND IN_PROGRESS zones all three bosses into combat and starts energy, warning, ultimate, and Berserk events.
lifecycle.phase_model: No discrete phase transition; repeating synchronized energy/ultimate cycles with platform-local events.
lifecycle.reset: Boss evade calls _EnterEvadeMode, disengages each encounter frame, despawns summons, and _DespawnAtEvade; instance cancels global events and resets skywall effects/hurricane vehicles.
lifecycle.completion: On the final councillor death the instance reaches DONE, unlocks Al'Akir, and calls ACTION_CONCLAVE_DEFEATED. Exact retail loot/credit/achievement semantics are not proven.
lifecycle.failure_and_respawn: Current guide says a missed 60-second synchronization causes full-health respawn; repository has gathering-strength logic but no explicit retail-window timer. Keep reset semantics blocked.
lifecycle.achievement: Icy Veins describes Stay Chill as seven Wind Chill stacks on everyone; source declares spell 94119 but does not invoke it in this file. Do not certify achievement credit.
